title: UI/UX Design
tagline: Generate design token palettes, design systems, and responsive layout wireframes

cases.title: Dark-Mode Design Token System (CSS/Tailwind)
cases.description: Generate harmonious semantic tokens for backgrounds, borders, accents, and contrast ratios.
cases.prompt: Design a complete dark-theme token system with WCAG AAA contrast for text, subtle hairline borders, and glowing primary accents.

cases.title: Micro-Interaction & Motion Specs
cases.description: Define easing curves, spring physics, and transition durations for fluid 60fps UI feedback.
cases.prompt: Specify animation timings and bezier curves for modal entry, dropdown expansion, and hover elevation states.
cases.sample_output: Motion specifications defined: 150ms ease-out (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) for hovers, 250ms for slide-over panels.

cases.title: Desktop Multi-Pane Wireframe Layout
cases.description: Create responsive 3-pane layout specs (Sidebar, Main Stage, Inspector) with collapse thresholds.
cases.prompt: Design a multi-pane desktop layout specification supporting collapsible sidebars, flexible canvas, and responsive breakpoints.
cases.sample_output: Multi-pane layout specification generated: Zone A (280px fixed), Zone B (flex-1 min 600px), Zone C (320px collapsible).

cases.title: Accessible Color Contrast Audit Matrix
cases.description: Evaluate APCA and WCAG 2.1 color contrast across every text/background pair in the theme.
cases.prompt: Audit the palette contrast for disabled, hover, and active states against WCAG AA 4.5:1 standards.
cases.sample_output: Contrast audit: 18 color combinations tested. All pass WCAG AA (>= 4.5:1) with text-primary achieving 15.2:1 contrast ratio.
